intents.response: You can explore all local farmers markets right here! Use our Market Directory to filter by Area (Downtown, Clifton, Gulshan, etc.), Day, or specific Produce.
Here are the markets operating today based on our live schedule:
Fresh seasonal produce changes with the weather! Check out our seasonal recommendations in the Produce Guide:
Fresh vine-ripened tomatoes are typically available at Greenfield Fresh Market, Riverside Farmers Market, Fresh Corner Market, and Green Basket Market.
Sweet golden mangoes are available at Garden Harvest Market, Central Green Basket, Harvest Lane Market, and Riverside Harvest Hub.

The following markets operate every Saturday: Greenfield Fresh Market (Downtown), Garden Harvest Market (Clifton), Central Green Basket (Gulshan), Harvest Lane Market (South District), Riverside Harvest Hub (Riverside), and Orchard Lane Market (South District).

FreshFind is simple: 1. Discover nearby farmers markets. 2. Explore operating hours, addresses, and available produce. 3. Bookmark your favorite spots with session notes. 4. Visit and enjoy fresh food closer to home!
You can save any market or produce item by tapping the heart icon (♡). Access your saved list anytime and even add session notes or export them to a file!
Most markets operate morning to mid-afternoon (e.g., 08:00 AM – 02:00 PM). Each market's complete 7-day schedule is listed on its detail page with live open/closed status.
Our team is here to help! You can reach FreshFind through our Contact Us page or find our physical community hub coordinates on the map.
